Questions, answered.

What is Scalio?+

Scalio is AI that runs marketing for your business — photoshoots, Reels, daily posts, replies and ads — around the clock. You set it up once; it keeps your business showing up online.

Who is Scalio for?+

Any Indian business that wants to grow. Product sellers — fashion, D2C, sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho — and local businesses like restaurants, salons, gyms, clinics and consultants.

What does Scalio actually do?+

It shoots studio-quality photos from your phone pictures, makes Reels in 10+ Indian languages, plans and publishes a month of posts, keeps your website and Google profile in shape, runs ads, and replies to reviews — the whole job, not one tool.

Do I need design or marketing skills?+

No. Scalio learns your business from your website, social profiles and a guided setup, then works on its own. You approve; it does.

Where do I use it?+

On the web at web.scalio.app, or from the iOS and Android apps. Most owners set it up on a laptop and let the phone app keep them posted.

Does Scalio support Indian languages?+

Yes — Hindi, Tamil, Bangla, Telugu, Marathi and many more. Reach customers across India, not just English speakers.

Will the content match my business?+

Yes. Scalio learns your catalogue, visual style and tone during setup, so every photo, Reel and reply feels like your business. You can fine-tune anything manually.

Can I try it for free?+

Yes. Set up your business free, let Scalio learn how your business looks and sounds, and see what it creates before choosing a plan.

What do the plans cost?+

Starter is ₹999/month with 60 creative credits, a full month of social media posting, 10 stories and access for 1 person. Professional is ₹1,999/month with 200 creative credits, a full month of social media posting, 25 stories, more edits and access for up to 5 people. Professional also includes a website for your business, AI replies to customer messages and Google Business Profile tools for up to 5 locations. Each plan includes 30 social posts per month, separately from your creative credits. Final pricing and available offers are shown at checkout.
